chunks: The illustrious Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. 'Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may God be pleased with him) narrated to me. He said: Sa'd b. 'Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. 'Isa narrated to us from al-Husayn b. Sa'id from Hammad b. 'Isa from Ibrahim b. 'Umar al-Yamani from Abu'l-Tufayl from Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. 'Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon them both) from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of God (blessings of God be upon him and his family) said to the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him): "Write what I dictate to you." So he said: "O Prophet of God, do you fear that I may forget?" So he (blessings of God be upon him and his family) said: "I do not fear that you will forget, for I have prayed to God for you that He may protect you and not cause you to forget. But rather, write for your partners." He said: I said: "Who are my partners, O Prophet of God?" He said: "The Imams from your loins.

By them my nation will receive rain, by them their supplications will be answered, by them God will ward off their calamities, and by them mercy will descend from the heavens. And this is the first of them." And he pointed with his hand to al-Hasan b. 'Ali (peace be upon him). Then he pointed with his hand to al-Husayn (peace be upon him). Then he said: "The Imams are from his progeny."

key_terms.الائمة من ولدك: The Imams from your loins — the divinely designated leaders from the lineage of Imam 'Ali
key_terms.البلاء: Calamity/tribulation — hardships that are averted from the community through the Imams' spiritual station
key_terms.الغيث: The rain — symbolizing divine provision and blessings that descend through the Imams' intercession
key_terms.شركائك: Your partners — referring to the Imams who share with 'Ali in the responsibility of leadership and guidance

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the Imams from Imam Ali's progeny being a means of divine mercy and answered prayers?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated through Imam al-Baqir (AS) from his forefathers, the Prophet Muhammad (S) instructs Imam 'Ali (AS) to write down what he dictates. When 'Ali asks whether the Prophet fears he may forget, the Prophet responds that God has already granted 'Ali protection from forgetfulness through his supplication — rather, the writing is intended for 'Ali's 'partners' (shuraka'). Upon 'Ali's inquiry about who these partners are, the Prophet identifies them as the Imams from 'Ali's progeny, through whom the Muslim nation receives rain, has its prayers answered, is spared from calamity, and receives divine mercy. The Prophet then physically designates al-Hasan (AS) as the first of these Imams, followed by al-Husayn (AS), declaring that the remaining Imams come from al-Husayn's lineage.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father (ra) narrated to me. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa narrated to us from al-Husayn b. Sa`id from Hammad b. `Isa from Ibrahim b. `Umar al-Yamani from Abi’l Tufayl from Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir (as) from his forefathers (as). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said to Amir al-Mu’minin (as): “Write what I will dictate to you.” He said: “O Prophet of Allah! Do you fear that I may forget?” So, he (s) said: “I do not fear that you will forget, because I have prayed to Allah that He may protect you from forgetfulness. Rather, write for your partners.” He said: I said: “Who are my partners, O Prophet of Allah?” He said: “The Imams from your loins,

by whom my Nation will receive rain, by whom their supplications will be answered, by whom Allah will ward of their calamities, by whom mercy will descend from the heavens, and he is the first of them.” And he pointed to al-Hasan (as) with his hand. Then, he pointed to al-Husayn (as) with his hand and said: “The Imams are from his loins.”
